name: Claude chat
description: Claude Code as a chat in the sidebar or a tab, working in your vault: it reads, edits and searches your notes while you watch, asking before it changes anything. Runs your own claude CLI on the server's machine (signed in to your Claude account); conversations stay on that machine.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: To hand a question or a task to Claude Code in the vault and get its answer: `claude_chat_ask` (the user sees the conversation in Claude chat).

mode.label: Permissions
mode.description: ask before edits: Claude asks before it changes a file or runs a command; accept edits: it edits notes without asking, but still asks before commands; plan only: it reads and plans, changing nothing

model.label: Model
model.description: the model new messages use, as claude --model takes it (opus, sonnet, haiku or a full name); Claude Code's default when left out

currentNote.label: Send the open note
currentNote.description: tells Claude which note is open in the focused tab with each message (a chip in the chat you can remove)

allowUsers.label: Other tailnet logins
allowUsers.description: tailnet logins besides this machine's owner that may chat (it runs Claude Code on this machine), like someone@example.com
